focused_rereview.change_verified: Reverting exactly the four changes recorded at the end of content/batches/005-notes.md (delete imageBrief/imageAlt on training, tabletten and feestje; restore 'an older male teacher' in the toets brief) and re-serialising with the file's own two-space JSON format reproduces the previously reviewed hash byte for byte, so no script, question, key, evidence or other field changed. image_fields.training: pass: office scene beside the female supervisor's desk; no calendar, no clock, no screen text, so neither the day (q1), the shoes (q2) nor the training (q3) is shown; alt 'Karim praat op kantoor met zijn leidinggevende.' is neutral Dutch; 'Karim' is the exact cast key and expands (man in his thirties, short black hair and beard, grey jacket), matching m-adult; the female supervisor matches f-adult.
image_fields.tabletten: pass: pharmacy counter, the assistant hands mevrouw Bakker a small box; no labels, no text, no clock, so neither the forgotten-tablet rule (q1) nor the pick-up day (q2) is shown; alt neutral. 'mevrouw Bakker' is written in lower case on purpose: scripts/illustrate.ts expandCast matches cast keys case-sensitively, so this spelling expands (woman of about 65, short white hair, red cardigan) while 'Mevrouw Bakker' would not; f-older for mevrouw Bakker and f-adult for the assistant match.
image_fields.feestje: pass: Roos at meneer De Vries's open front door; no house number, no text, no clock, so neither the music time (q1) nor her purpose (q2) is shown; the bicycle by the wall is generic Dutch scenery and not a tested fact; alt neutral; 'Roos' and 'meneer De Vries' both expand; f-young and m-older match the cast ages (young woman, man of about 60).
image_fields.toets: pass: only the teacher's age changed; 'a male teacher of about forty' agrees with the m-adult voice (the full review had suggested about fifty; forty is equally an adult rather than an older voice); the rest of the brief and the unchanged alt still reveal nothing.

observations_not_blocking: Items training, tabletten and feestje have no imageBrief/imageAlt; blueprint §4.2 describes video-type conversations as audio with one still. Decide before the hash gate; adding briefs later changes the file hash and needs a focused re-review.

Item bus uses the narrator role (also the question voice) for a live driver announcement, as config/voices.json prescribes for omroep; m-adult is an alternative if the fragment voice should differ from the question reader.

Purpose questions in items training and parkeervergunning come last and their key is hinted at by earlier prompts of the same fragment; the app shows one question at a time, so this only mildly eases them, as in the official exam.
Item voetbal q2 distractor 'Een regenjas.' repeats the raincoat pattern of A2:listening:batch001-schoolreis:1; optional swap if both items are ever drilled together.
Item toets image brief says 'older male teacher' while the voice is m-adult; align at the illustration stage.

Media stage: item tabletten pairs two female voices (f-adult, f-older); check they are distinct in the rendered dialogue. Digit strings in scripts rely on Dutch TTS reading; no phone number is answer-relevant.
diversity_review: Within the batch the twelve settings, purposes and information structures are distinct, and all six A2 listening task types and all eight domains are used. No listening setting from blueprint §9 is repeated and no item is an earlier item with new names or numbers. Cross-part setting re-use exists with the uncatalogued reading batch 004 (parkeervergunning, telefoonwinkel, apotheek with mevrouw Bakker, pin-only bus tickets); each tests different facts through a different channel and reading and listening never share a set, so it is acceptable but the coordinator should know these settings now appear twice. Two of twelve items are wonen-buurt, which §9 asks to use sparingly; the balance across the other domains is good. First nieuws and reclame items in the bank.
limitations: This is an AI editorial review of scripts before audio exists. It does not replace review by a Dutch-language educator, learner trials or psychometric calibration, and it does not establish equivalence with the official DUO exam. The A2 label remains an unvalidated authoring target on every item.
Originality was judged by plausibility and by a phrase scan against this project's own catalogue and batch 004, not by comparison with official practice-exam audio.
